## Description

Briefly describe the purpose of this pull request and the changes made.

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or UI enhancement
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `perf`: Performance optimization
- [ ] `a11y`: Accessibility improvement
- [ ] `test`: New or updated tests
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] Ran `npm run lint` with 0 warnings/errors
- [ ] Ran `npm test` and all suites passed
- [ ] Ran `npm run build` with clean production bundle
- [ ] Tested keyboard navigation (`Tab` / `:focus-visible` states)
- [ ] Verified both Dark and Light theme contrast
